svg.title: Does the revised food preference persist?

cc:Work.dc:title: Does the revised food preference persist?
cc:Work.dc:description: Whiskers: ±1 family SE. Each lineage has 128 families, averaging both initial food rules within family. Only 0, 1 and 33 turns were measured. Lines join these snapshots. The one-turn snapshot is descriptive. S is a signed probability difference. G includes all assigned lives and uses a fresh 50-turn grid readout. Dashed S line: 0.10. Full retention gates also require paired history effects and the registered 0.05 loss bound. Audit SHA256: d038dbbcc1062fecde4f20b83eb83e2c7032a873a810cd9cdcced7e08ee02249 Comparison SHA256: f4f103872e780bbf4c19d3200b5e7356d8c3dbe72ccc4ee3be957e664fea1197
